the internship in vocational higher school should be organized in a way that students are satisfied and that the school support is adequate.

students' satisfaction with internship is positively influenced by the quality of the work environment, the mentor's objectiveness and school support during internship, and negatively by the lack of consistency of the curriculum with the internship program and by the lack of adequate rewarding overtime.

the following: (1) students' satisfaction with the mentor, internship organization and the school support; (2) the relationship between students' satisfaction and their experience, attitude, gender and year of study; and (3) the relationship between the students' experience and attitude.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

students are satisfied with the internship program in the hospitality higher education, but there is room for improvement in the areas of school support during internship and better alignment of theoretical and practical knowledge.
the hospitality students were satisfied with the internship, and that they were given the opportunity to apply their knowledge and skills in practice.

the students' satisfaction with internship is affected by many factors, which should be considered when organizing internship in vocational higher educations, and that the students are more satisfied with the internship in which they have been given the opportunity to work in the profession, which is also confirmed by the fact that students with a longer work experience are more satisfied.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

internship in vocational higher hospitality education should be organized in a way that would allow students to acquire the skills and competences needed in the labor market, to develop their expertise and to be satisfied with their internship experience.
students should be given a chance to work in a profession, which is related to their field of study, and that they should be given the possibility to acquire new skills.
students who are more satisfied with the internship are more likely to be satisfied with the program of studies and to recommend it to their peers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
students' satisfaction with internship is positively affected by the mentor, the school support and the work environment.
internship is not only an opportunity to develop practical skills, but also to gain a deeper insight into the work culture.
the internship program should be well aligned with the curriculum and the students' expectations.
